raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With the toktier backend (#44373, which this PR stacks on) the encode still runs in the tokenizer manager's process, on the event loop's thread. One long encode then holds the loop, and a short session append waits behind a whole long request. toktier ships a worker pool for this. With `TOKTIER_SGLANG_SESSION_KEY=contextvar`, keyed requests go to a home worker that holds their session state. Stateless requests (every request in `off` mode, or a long keyless one in `contextvar` mode) enter a shared shortest-first queue, cut into chunks once they reach `TOKTIER_SGLANG_SCHED_CHUNK_MIN_CHARS` characters (131072 by default). In the default `auto` mode each request is a content lookup on a worker chosen from the start of the text, never chunked, with the same ids. A request the pool cannot answer is encoded in process as before. The pool lives in toktier; SGLang needs one hook to await it. The design and the measurements are in [RFC #44374](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/44374), roadmap item 2, and in the [Delta Tokenizer paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19801) (arXiv:2610.19801), §4.5 and §4.6.

## Modifications

One hunk in `TokenizerManager._tokenize_texts`. When the backend is `toktier` and the input is plain text (a string or a list of strings), the method awaits `toktier.integrations.sglang.tokenize_texts_with_pool`, which returns `(input_ids, None)`. With any other input (cross-encoder pairs, EmbeddingGemma, an empty string), or with no pool running, the call returns `None` and the method continues unchanged. The pool starts only when `TOKTIER_SGLANG_SCHED_WORKERS` is set above zero, so nothing changes by default even with the backend on. Worker processes are spawned (`multiprocessing` "spawn" context) and closed with the wrapper.

There is also a CPU unit test, `test/registered/unit/managers/test_toktier_pool.py`, skipped unless toktier (>= 0.3.0) is installed. toktier 0.3.0 is on PyPI (`pip install 'sglang[toktier]'` with #44373), so the test now runs instead of skipping.

Draft, stacked on #44373; the diff shows both, including the backend's test commit, until that one lands.

## Accuracy Tests

The unit test, run locally against the toktier 0.3.0 release, has 6 tests and all pass. The pool starts with two workers. A single text and a batch of texts are answered by the pool with ids equal to the Hugging Face tokenizer's. A two-turn session under a bound `session_id` with `TOKTIER_SGLANG_SESSION_KEY=contextvar` gets the same ids, and the wrapper's `stats()` shows both turns on the pool's session route, served by one worker; in the default `auto` mode the same session gets the same ids by content lookup on the pool. Cross-encoder input, an empty string, text pairs and a plain Hugging Face tokenizer fall through (`None`). The paper's serving runs with the pool reported the same prompt-token counts as the reference and no difference in 2,195 and 2,268 independent re-encodes of served text.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Warm turns on SGLang v0.5.19 with Qwen3-8B (bf16) on an RTX PRO 6000 and the HTTP process pinned to 16 cores of an AMD EPYC 9115, from the paper. The full tables are there and in the RFC.

| Setting | Reference | toktier in process | toktier pool |
|---|---|---|---|
| P99 TTFT, twelve 100K-character sessions, 24 warm turns/s | 995 ms | 103 ms | 105 ms |
| P99 TTFT, same sessions at 8 turns/s, plus four one-million-character stateless requests every 8 s (over the model's context, declined after tokenization, so they load only the front end) | 1,441 ms | 166 ms | 63 ms |
| P99 TTFT, same sessions, plus a repeated ~100K-token document served from the prefix cache | 498 ms | 66.5 ms | 67.5 ms |

The pool's own cost is the text and the ids crossing a process boundary, about 2 ms at 100K tokens.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (The pool's settings are documented in toktier's `docs/integration/sglang.md`.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""Verification that --tokenizer-backend=toktier wraps the tokenizer the
+TokenizerManager loads, and that every encode path of that wrapper returns
+the ids a from-scratch encode by the Hugging Face tokenizer returns.
+
+Requires toktier >= 0.3.0 (which ships the SGLang adapter); skipped otherwise.
+No server is started.
+"""
+
+import os
+import unittest
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.tokenizer_manager import (
+    _toktier_session_scope,
+    _wrap_tokenizer_with_toktier,
+)
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs, set_global_server_args_for_tokenizer
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=40, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+try:
+    from toktier.integrations import sglang as toktier_sglang
+
+    HAS_TOKTIER_ADAPTER = True
+except ImportError:
+    HAS_TOKTIER_ADAPTER = False
+
+# A byte-level BPE tokenizer toktier serves itself, and a WordPiece tokenizer
+# outside its families, which the wrapper must pass through.
+BPE_MODEL = "Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B"
+WORDPIECE_MODEL = "bert-base-uncased"
+
+TRANSCRIPT = (
+    "<|im_start|>user\nSummarize the following.\n"
+    + "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. " * 300
+    + "<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n"
+)
+NEXT_TURN = (
+    "Sure. The fox is quick and the dog is lazy.<|im_end|>\n"
+    "<|im_start|>user\nShorter.<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n"
+)
+
+
+def _set_backend(backend):
+    set_global_server_args_for_tokenizer(
+        ServerArgs(model_path="dummy", tokenizer_backend=backend)
+    )
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(HAS_TOKTIER_ADAPTER, "toktier package (>= 0.3.0) not installed")
+class TestToktierBackend(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        _set_backend("toktier")
+        self.hf = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(BPE_MODEL)
+        self.wrapped = _wrap_tokenizer_with_toktier(self.hf)
+
+    def test_wrapper_is_applied_once(self):
+        self.assertIsInstance(self.wrapped, toktier_sglang.SGLangToktierTokenizer)
+        self.assertIs(_wrap_tokenizer_with_toktier(self.wrapped), self.wrapped)
+
+    def test_full_encode_matches_reference(self):
+        for text in ("Hello, world!", TRANSCRIPT, TRANSCRIPT + NEXT_TURN):
+            self.assertEqual(self.wrapped.encode(text), self.hf.encode(text))
+            self.assertEqual(
+                self.wrapped(text)["input_ids"], self.hf(text)["input_ids"]
+            )
+
+    def test_session_append_matches_reference(self):
+        # The bound session_id is read in "contextvar" mode; the default
+        # "auto" mode looks sessions up by content instead.
+        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"TOKTIER_SGLANG_SESSION_KEY": "contextvar"}):
+            wrapped = _wrap_tokenizer_with_toktier(
+                AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(BPE_MODEL)
+            )
+        request = SimpleNamespace(session_id="session-1", cache_salt=None, rid="r1")
+        with _toktier_session_scope(request):
+            first = wrapped.encode(TRANSCRIPT)
+            second = wrapped.encode(TRANSCRIPT + NEXT_TURN)
+        self.assertEqual(first, self.hf.encode(TRANSCRIPT))
+        self.assertEqual(second, self.hf.encode(TRANSCRIPT + NEXT_TURN))
+        stats = wrapped.stats()
+        self.assertEqual(stats["how"], {"session": 2})
+        # The second turn extends the first, so it is served as an append.
+        self.assertEqual(stats["store"]["session_appends"], 1)
+
+    def test_default_mode_is_content_lookup(self):
+        # Without TOKTIER_SGLANG_SESSION_KEY the bound session_id is not read;
+        # a turn that extends a stored text is still served as an append.
+        with patch.dict(os.environ):
+            os.environ.pop("TOKTIER_SGLANG_SESSION_KEY", None)
+            wrapped = _wrap_tokenizer_with_toktier(
+                AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(BPE_MODEL)
+            )
+        request = SimpleNamespace(session_id="session-1", cache_salt=None, rid="r1")
+        with _toktier_session_scope(request):
+            first = wrapped.encode(TRANSCRIPT)
+            second = wrapped.encode(TRANSCRIPT + NEXT_TURN)
+        self.assertEqual(first, self.hf.encode(TRANSCRIPT))
+        self.assertEqual(second, self.hf.encode(TRANSCRIPT + NEXT_TURN))
+        stats = wrapped.stats()
+        self.assertEqual(stats["how"], {"auto": 2})
+        self.assertEqual(stats["store"]["auto_appends"], 1)
+
+    def test_session_scope_binds_session_id_then_cache_salt(self):
+        key = toktier_sglang.SESSION_KEY
+        scope = _toktier_session_scope
+        with scope(SimpleNamespace(session_id="s", cache_salt="salt")):
+            self.assertEqual(key.get(None), "s")
+        with scope(SimpleNamespace(session_id=None, cache_salt="salt")):
+            self.assertEqual(key.get(None), "salt")
+        # Server-side continuation sends only the new turn, so no key.
+        with scope(SimpleNamespace(session_id="s", session_params={"id": "x"})):
+            self.assertIsNone(key.get(None))
+        self.assertIsNone(key.get(None))
+
+    def test_chunked_full_encode_matches_reference(self):
+        # In "contextvar" mode a request without a key is stateless, so one
+        # of at least CHUNKED_MIN_CHARS characters takes the chunked route.
+        chunked = {
+            "TOKTIER_SGLANG_SESSION_KEY": "contextvar",
+            "TOKTIER_SGLANG_CHUNKED_MIN_CHARS": "4096",
+            "TOKTIER_SGLANG_CHUNKED_K": "4",
+        }
+        with patch.dict(os.environ, chunked):
+            wrapped = _wrap_tokenizer_with_toktier(
+                AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(BPE_MODEL)
+            )
+        text = (TRANSCRIPT + NEXT_TURN) * 4
+        self.assertEqual(wrapped.encode(text), self.hf.encode(text))
+        stats = wrapped.stats()
+        self.assertEqual(stats["how"], {"chunked": 1})
+        self.assertEqual(stats["chunked"]["applied"], 1)
+
+    def test_unmodeled_call_shapes_are_delegated(self):
+        first, second = "first sentence", "second sentence"
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self.wrapped(first, second)["input_ids"],
+            self.hf(first, second)["input_ids"],
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self.wrapped(TRANSCRIPT, truncation=True, max_length=16)["input_ids"],
+            self.hf(TRANSCRIPT, truncation=True, max_length=16)["input_ids"],
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self.wrapped(first, return_token_type_ids=True)["token_type_ids"],
+            self.hf(first, return_token_type_ids=True)["token_type_ids"],
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(self.wrapped.decode(self.hf.encode(first)), first)
+
+    def test_tokenizer_outside_toktier_families_passes_through(self):
+        hf = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(WORDPIECE_MODEL)
+        wrapped = _wrap_tokenizer_with_toktier(hf)
+        for text in ("Hello, world!", TRANSCRIPT):
+            self.assertEqual(wrapped.encode(text), hf.encode(text))
+            self.assertEqual(wrapped(text)["input_ids"], hf(text)["input_ids"])
+
+    def test_other_backends_get_a_noop_scope(self):
+        _set_backend("huggingface")
+        self.assertIsInstance(
+            _toktier_session_scope(SimpleNamespace(session_id="s")), nullcontext
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

@@ -0,0 +1,159 @@
+"""Verification of the toktier worker pool behind --tokenizer-backend=toktier:
+with TOKTIER_SGLANG_SCHED_WORKERS > 0, TokenizerManager._tokenize_texts awaits
+plain text encodes from the pool, and every id it returns equals a from-scratch
+encode by the Hugging Face tokenizer. Inputs the pool does not take fall through
+to the existing path.
+
+Requires toktier >= 0.3.0 (which ships the adapter and the pool); skipped
+otherwise. No server is started; the pool's worker processes are.
+"""
+
+import asyncio
+import os
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.tokenizer_manager import (
+    TokenizerManager,
+    _toktier_session_scope,
+    _wrap_tokenizer_with_toktier,
+)
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs, set_global_server_args_for_tokenizer
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=90, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+try:
+    from toktier.integrations import sglang as toktier_sglang
+
+    HAS_TOKTIER_ADAPTER = True
+except ImportError:
+    HAS_TOKTIER_ADAPTER = False
+
+MODEL = "Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B"
+
+TRANSCRIPT = (
+    "<|im_start|>user\nSummarize the following.\n"
+    + "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. " * 300
+    + "<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n"
+)
+NEXT_TURN = (
+    "Sure. The fox is quick and the dog is lazy.<|im_end|>\n"
+    "<|im_start|>user\nShorter.<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n"
+)
+
+
+def _manager(tokenizer):
+    """A bare TokenizerManager with the fields _tokenize_texts reads."""
+    set_global_server_args_for_tokenizer(
+        ServerArgs(model_path="dummy", tokenizer_backend="toktier")
+    )
+    manager = TokenizerManager.__new__(TokenizerManager)
+    manager.tokenizer = tokenizer
+    manager.async_dynamic_batch_tokenizer = None
+    manager.model_config = SimpleNamespace(is_embedding_gemma=False)
+    return manager
+
+
+def _pool_wrapper(session_key=None):
+    """A wrapper with its own pool of two workers, in the given session-key
+    mode (None: the variable unset, so the adapter's default applies)."""
+    with patch.dict(os.environ, {"TOKTIER_SGLANG_SCHED_WORKERS": "2"}):
+        if session_key is None:
+            os.environ.pop("TOKTIER_SGLANG_SESSION_KEY", None)
+        else:
+            os.environ["TOKTIER_SGLANG_SESSION_KEY"] = session_key
+        return _wrap_tokenizer_with_toktier(AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL))
+
+
+def _two_turns(manager):
+    """Two turns of one session through _tokenize_texts, the second
+    extending the first."""
+    request = SimpleNamespace(session_id="session-pool", cache_salt=None, rid="r1")
+
+    async def run():
+        with _toktier_session_scope(request):
+            first, _ = await manager._tokenize_texts(TRANSCRIPT)
+            second, _ = await manager._tokenize_texts(TRANSCRIPT + NEXT_TURN)
+        return first, second
+
+    return asyncio.run(run())
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(HAS_TOKTIER_ADAPTER, "toktier package (>= 0.3.0) not installed")
+class TestToktierPool(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        # One pool of two worker processes for the whole class.
+        cls.hf = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL)
+        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"TOKTIER_SGLANG_SCHED_WORKERS": "2"}):
+            cls.wrapped = _wrap_tokenizer_with_toktier(
+                AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL)
+            )
+        cls.manager = _manager(cls.wrapped)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        cls.wrapped.close()
+
+    def test_pool_is_running(self):
+        self.assertIsNotNone(self.wrapped.scheduler)
+
+    def test_single_text_is_answered_by_the_pool(self):
+        for text in ("Hello, world!", TRANSCRIPT):
+            ids, token_type_ids = asyncio.run(self.manager._tokenize_texts(text))
+            self.assertEqual(ids, self.hf.encode(text))
+            self.assertIsNone(token_type_ids)
+
+    def test_batch_of_texts_is_answered_by_the_pool(self):
+        texts = ["Hello, world!", TRANSCRIPT, TRANSCRIPT + NEXT_TURN]
+        rows, token_type_ids = asyncio.run(self.manager._tokenize_texts(texts))
+        self.assertEqual(rows, [self.hf.encode(t) for t in texts])
+        self.assertIsNone(token_type_ids)
+
+    def test_session_append_through_the_pool_matches_reference(self):
+        # The bound session_id is read in "contextvar" mode, and a keyed
+        # request is served on its home worker's session path; the default
+        # "auto" mode looks sessions up by content instead.
+        wrapped = _pool_wrapper("contextvar")
+        self.addCleanup(wrapped.close)
+        first, second = _two_turns(_manager(wrapped))
+        self.assertEqual(first, self.hf.encode(TRANSCRIPT))
+        self.assertEqual(second, self.hf.encode(TRANSCRIPT + NEXT_TURN))
+        stats = wrapped.stats()
+        self.assertEqual(stats["how"], {"sched_session": 2})
+        # Both turns went to the same worker, the session's home.
+        self.assertEqual(list(stats["scheduler"]["tasks_by_worker"].values()), [2])
+
+    def test_default_mode_is_content_lookup_on_the_pool(self):
+        # Without TOKTIER_SGLANG_SESSION_KEY the bound session_id is not read;
+        # both turns are served by content lookup on the worker chosen from
+        # the text's start.
+        wrapped = _pool_wrapper()
+        self.addCleanup(wrapped.close)
+        first, second = _two_turns(_manager(wrapped))
+        self.assertEqual(first, self.hf.encode(TRANSCRIPT))
+        self.assertEqual(second, self.hf.encode(TRANSCRIPT + NEXT_TURN))
+        stats = wrapped.stats()
+        self.assertEqual(stats["how"], {"sched_auto": 2})
+        self.assertEqual(list(stats["scheduler"]["tasks_by_worker"].values()), [2])
+
+    def test_inputs_the_pool_does_not_take_fall_through(self):
+        pool = toktier_sglang.tokenize_texts_with_pool
+
+        async def run():
+            cross = await pool(self.manager, "Hello, world!", is_cross_encoder=True)
+            empty = await pool(self.manager, "")
+            pairs = await pool(self.manager, [("a", "b")])
+            plain = await pool(_manager(self.hf), "Hello")
+            return cross, empty, pairs, plain
+
+        self.assertEqual(asyncio.run(run()), (None, None, None, None))
+
